tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (99)rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i snang brnyan ni/dmar por 'char kha'i gzi 'bar ba'i/gzhon nu ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor can/de ring snyir la ngal gso mdzod/dam pa'i cha
(99)rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i snang brnyan ni/dmar por 'char kha'i gzi 'bar ba'i/gzhon nu ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor can/de ring snyir la ngal gso mdzod/dam pa'i cha

tei:div.tei:p: (99)rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i snang brnyan ni/ dmar por 'char kha'i gzi 'bar ba'i/ gzhon nu ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor can/ de ring snyir la ngal gso mdzod/ dam pa'i chos mngon pa la/ lung dang rig pa'i mngon pa gnyis las/ 'dir rig pa'i mngon pa'i rnal dag blo rtags gi rim pa mdor bsdus su bshad pa/ blo rig bshad pa/ rtags rig bshad pa'o/ dang po la blo rig dngos dang*/ de la dpyad pa'i sgo bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la tshad ma bshad pa dang*/ tshad min bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la gsum/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ grangs nges bstan pa'o/ dang po gsar du mi bsru ba tshad ma'i mtshan nyid/ gsar du zhes pa dang*/ mi bsru ba zhes pa dang*/ rigs pa zhes pa gsum gyi zur tshang dgos so/ gnyis pa dbye ba la mngon sum dang rjes dpag gnyis/ dang po mngon sum la gsum/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ rgyu mtshan bshad pa'o/ dang po (100)rtog bral ma 'khrul ba'i gsar du mi bsru ba'i shes pa mngon sum tshad ma'i mtshan nyid/ de la zung snga ma gsum gyi khar rtog bral zhes pa dang*/ ma 'khrul ba zhes pa'i khyad par tshang dgos so/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ dbang mngon/ yid mngon/ rang rig mngon sum/ rnal 'byor mngon sum bzhi yod la/ dbang mngon dbang bo'i bdag rkyen gyi khyad par gyis lnga dang*/ rnal 'byor mngon sum la 'jig rten dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa gnyis yod do/ gsum pa rgyu mtshan bzhi ste/ dbang mngon chos can/ khyoed la de ltar brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bdag rkyen dbang bo la brten pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yid mngon chos can/ khyod la de ltar brdzod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bdag rkyen yid dbang la brten pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rang rig chos can/ khyod la de ltar brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gzung rnams rang nyid la kha na kho nar phyogs pa'i 'dzin rnam yan gar ba yin pa'i (101)phyir/ bzhi pa rnal 'byor mngon sum chos can/

khyod la de ltar brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bdag rkyen rnal 'byor la brten pa'i mngon sum yin pa'i phyir ro/ gnyis pa rjes dpag tshad ma la gsum/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ rjes dpag gi go ba'o/ dang po ni/ rang yul lkog gyur la rgyu mtshan yang dag la brten pas gsar du mi bsru ba'i rig pa rjes dpag tshad ma'i mtshan nyid/ de la zur snga ma gsum gyi khar yul lkog gyur zhes pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan zhes pa dang*/ yang dag zhes pa'i khyad par rnams tshang dgos so/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ dngos po stob zhugs kyi rjes dpag yid ches kyi rjes dpag dpes nyer mjal gyi rjes dpag grags pa'i rjes dpag go de dag rgyu mtshan gyi sgo nas dbye ba ste dang po/ du ldan gyi la la du ba mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis der me yod pa dpag pa dang*/ sgra byas pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis mi rtag pa yin par (102)dpag pa'o/ gnyis pa ston pa'i bka' dpyad gsum dag pa la brten te las 'bras mi bsru bang rtogs pa'o/ gsum pa rā rmig nag pos lkog shal sogs la brten nas ba min ba glang dang 'dra bar dgos pa'o/ bzhi ba rtog yul na yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis ri bong can zla ba'i sgra brjod rung du dpag pa'o/ de dag la sgras brjod rigs kyi dbye na/ rang don rjes dpag dang*/ gzhan don rjes dpag go dang po ni rang gi sgrub byed kyis de rtags de rtogs pa na khyab 'brol nges pa'i bsgrub bya rtogs pa'o/ gnyis pa de sgrub la shes 'dod la zhugs pa'i/ sgrub ngag yan lag lnga ldan dang*/ gsum ldan du bkod nas rjes dpag bskyed pa ste/ dper na gang byas na mi rtag pas khyab ste/ dper na bul pa bzhin/ sgra yang byas so/ byas pa mi rtag par nges pas sgra mi rtag par nges so/ zhes pa lta bu'am/ yang na/ sgra chos can/ mi rtag te byas pa'i phyir/ dper na bum pa bzhin/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ 'di la'ang rtag (103)khyab ngos nas bsgrub bya la shes 'dod dang ma ldan par phyogs snga yang dag par mi 'gyur bas/

de ltar dbye ba la/ de yi log rtog gi ce gzhil ba la thal 'gyur ram/ sun 'byin sngon du 'gro dgos pas de gzhan nam gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa la sun 'byin dang*/ sgrub ngag yang gnyis dang*/ de'i gos pa shes pa la ltar snang gnyis re bzhi dang*/ don mngon gyur lkog gyur gnyis rang gis rtogs pa la mngon sum rjes dpag gnyis/ de gnyis kyi gol sa shes pa la ltang snang gnyis ste brgyad po la rtog ge'i tshig don brgyad zhes bya'o/ gsum pa rjes dpag gi go ba ni/ tshul gsum tshang ba'i rtags yang dag shes pa na/ tshul gsum so sor nges na blo ngor bsdams pa rtags 'dzin sems kyis rjes su don la dpag pas na'o/ gsum pa grangs nges ni/ gzhal bya la rang spyi gnyis yod pas tshad ma yang gnyis te/ gzhal bya rang mtshan snang yul lam/ dngos yul du byed pa mngon (104)sum byed pa la mngon sum tshad ma/ gzhal bya spyi mtshan dngos yul lam/ snang yul du byed pa rjes tshad ma'o/ de dag la yul gyi rganam pa shar lugs/ snang yul zhen yul sogs kyi khyad par sogs shes dgos pa mang du yod do/ gnyis pa tshad ma'i blo lal/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ grangs nges pa'i go ba'o/ dang po ni rang yul la gsur du mi bsru ba tshad min pa'i shes pa tshad min gyis/ gsar du dang mi bsru ba min pa'i khyad gnyis dang ldan na tshad min no/ des rtogs ma rtogs pa gnyis ka yod do/ gnyis pa dbye ba la/ spyir dbye ba mang yang log rtog sel ba'i dbang da byas na lnga/ log shes the tshom/ bcad shes/ yid dpyod/ snang la ma nges pa'o/ rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul la 'khrul ba'i rig pa rang log shes yin pa'i mtshan nyid/ de la rtogs pa dang rtogs med der gyu ba gnyis/ dang po la mtshan gzhi las 'brel med 'dzin/ gang zag gi bdag yod 'dzin/ sgra rtag 'dzin/ ri bong (105)rā 'dzin sogs dang*/ gnyis pa la dung sor 'dzin/ gangs ri sngo 'dzin rnams so/ rang yul la yid gnyis dang bcas pa'i semasabyung the tshom gyi mtshan nyid/

dbye na don 'gyur/ don mi 'gyur/ cha mnyam pa gsum yod/ gsum pa bcad shos ni/ tshad mas sgro 'dogs bcad shul gyis rang yul rtogs pa'i rig pa bcad shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na dgos par gyur ba'i bcad shes dang*/ rtogs med du gyur pa'i bcad shes gnyis yod la/ mtshan gzhi sngo 'dzin tshad ma skad cig gnyis pa phan dang*/ gnyis mi rtag par rtogs pa skad cig gnyis pa phan rnams so/ bzhi pa yid dpyod ni/ myong ba dang rtags yang dag gang la'ang ma brten par rang yul mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i zhen rig yid daspyod kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na lnga*/ rgyu mtshan med pa'i yid dpyod/ rgyu mtshan 'gal ba'i dang*/ rgyu mtshan ma nges pa'i dang*/ rgyu mtshan ma grub pa'i dang*/ rgyu mtshan log pa'i yid dpyod do/ (106)de dag gi mtshan gzhi'i rim pa bzhin/ rang gar sgra mi rtag pa'o snyam pa dang*/ sgra 'dus byas pa'i mi rtag pa dang*/ sgra byas pa yin pa rang la ma grub kyang gzhan zer la brten nas mi rtag pa dang*/ sgra mig shes kyi bzung bya min pa'i mi rtag par mthal gcig tu zhon sa rnams so/ lnga ba snang la ma nges pa ni/ rang yul la nges pa bral ba'i blo snang la ma ngos pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'di la dbye na/ der gyur pa'i dbang blo yid blo/ rang rig gsum yod de mtshan gzhi ni/ dbang mngon skad cig sa phan dang*/ rgyun gyi mthar re re skad cig dang po dbang blo mthar skyes pa'i yid mngon dang*/ rang rig skad cig pa phan rnams so/ gsum pa grangs nges pa ni/ spyir tshad min la mang du yod kyang*/ 'dir tshad min tshad mar 'khrul ba'i log rtog bzlog ched yin la/ de la ma rtog par tshad mar 'khrul ba dang*/ log rtog la tshad mar 'khrul ba dang*/ rang yul sgro 'dogs bcad shul gyi rtogs pa tshad mar 'khrul ba rnams so/ dag po la yul (107)ma nges pa dang*/ sgro 'dog legs par ma chod nas ma rtogs pa dang*/ sgro 'dogs gcod byed kyi rgyu mtshan ma nges nas ma rtogs pa rnams snang la ma nges pa dang*/

the tshom dang*/ yid dpyod rnams nges pa'i tshad mar mi 'khrul la/ log rtog la rtog med kyi dbang du byas nas 'khrul yin na log shes yin te rang gi gzung yul de 'dzin stangs kyi yul yang yin pa gang zhig gzungs yul 'khrul 'dzin stangs kyi yul yang ma yin 'khrul mi srid pa'i phyir rtog pa la 'khrul shes yin yang log shes kyis ma khyab te/ gzung yul la 'khrul yang 'dzin stangs kyi yul la yang ma 'khrul ba yod pa'i phyir/ de ltar na yul gyi gtso bo 'dzin stangs kyis yul la byas pa'i/ de blos bzung ba ltar med pa tshad mar 'khrul ba/ log shes nges pas ldog la/ tshad ma zhes pa yul gyi sgro 'dogs gcod byed yin la tshad ma skad cig dang po phan la sgro 'dogs med phyir/ der rtogs tshad mar (108)'khrul ba bcad shul nges pas bzlog go rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa/ de la dpyod pa'i sgo bstan pa la gsum/ mngon sum ltar snang ngos bzung ba/ rang yul snang tshul tshad ma yin min la brtags pa/ yul gyi rnam pa la brtag pa'o/ dang po la mngon sum ltar snang bzhi ste/ 'khrul rgyu yul yod pa'i de dang*/ 'khrul rgyu rten la yod pa'i de dang*/ 'khrul rgyu gnas la yod pa'i de dang*/ 'khrul rgyu de ma thag rkyen la yod pa'i mngon sum ltar snang ngo/ dang po ni 'gal me 'khor lo snang ba ste/ khyod 'khrul rgyu gyi bsgrod pa myur ba la yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dung la ser snang ste/ khyod 'khrul rgyu rten dbang bo la yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ljon shing 'gro bar snang ba te/ khyod 'khrul rgyu sdod gnas gru 'gro ba la yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi ba sa gzhi dmar por snang ba ste/ khyod 'khrul gzhi rang gi de ma thag rkyen rtog pa snga ma 'gag bzhin pa de la yod pa'i phyir/ de dag chos can/ mngon sum ltar snang yinate (109)rang yul la mi bsru ba min pa'i phyir/ der thal rang yul gyi gtso bo 'dzin stangs kyi yul la 'khrul ba'i blo yin pa'i phyir gnyis pa la/

nam mkha' la nyi zla snang ba'i mngon sum chos can/ khyod tshad ma min par thal/ nyi zla rang gi tshad las chung ba'i snang ba'i 'khrul shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na 'dod mi nus te rgyang rang por mthong ba'i mngon sum mi srid par 'gyur ro zer na/ ma khyab te tshad ma 'khrul yang rang gi 'dzin stangs kyi yul nyi zla la ma 'khrul ba'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ khyab te rang 'dzin stangs kyi yul la ma 'khrul na/ yul snang tshul gyi khyad par gzhan la 'khrul yang de 'khrul shes su mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ dpe na de nyi zla la tshad ma/ de dag gi tshad la 'khrul shes su bzhag go yang smig rgyu chur snang gi dbang shes chos can/ khyod 'khrul shes su thal/ smig rgyu de chu ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mi nus te dbang shes la smig rgyu gnas (110)tshul phyin ci ma log par snang ba'i phyir/ zer na yang rtsa bar ma khyab te dbang shes la smig rgyu chu dang 'dra bar snang gi chur ma snang ba'i phyir/ grub te khyod la chu dang mthun par snang ba na/ rtog pa'i dbang shes la snang lugs dang*/ yul gyi gnas sogs kyi chur 'khrul ba'i phyir/ dpe na dbang shes ma 'khrul bar rtogs pa 'khrul ba bzhed do/ 'di dang tho yor mir snang*/ thag khra sbrul snang sogs 'dra'o/ yang mthong bya chu phor ba gang gi go na yi dag la rnag khrag phor ba dang snang ba de chos can/ khyod log shes yin par thal/ snang yul te khrag ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na 'dod mi nus te 'gro ba gzhan gyi snang ba la tshad ma mi srid par 'gyur ro zer na/ rtsa ba'i rtags ma grub te/ yi dwags kyi dbang gi de'i go na rnag khrag tshad mas grub pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yul gyi rnam pa la brtags pa la/ yul khra 'dzin mngon sum de chos can/ yul gyi grangs ldan gyi rnam pa 'dzin pa'i shes pa rdzas so so (111)ba yin te yul sngo sor sogs mi gcig pa du mas rnam pa gtod pa gang zhig do dag ma lus par 'dzin pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/

'dod na 'dod mi nus te/ dus mnyam na shes pa du mar thal ba dang*/ mi mnyam na yul gyi cha yi grangs gi shes pa rim gyis skye ba nges par 'gyur ro zhes na/ 'di ni shin tu dka' ba'i gnas te 'phags yul na'ang gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa/ sna tshogs gnyis med pa/ sgong nga phyed tshal ba gsum byung shing*/ 'dir sna tshogs gnyis med pa ltar go na 'di ltar lan btab ste/ rtsa bar ma khyab te yul rdzas mi gcig pa du ma'i rnam pa yang gtad/ de dag gi rnam par yang skyes kyang rnam pa de dag dbang blo rdzas gcig pa ste/ shes pa rdzas gcig la rnam pa du mar snang ba'i phyir te/ yang gangs rī'i sngo snang dang du sor snang gi yul te chos can/ khyod gtan med du thal/ blo log shes kyis bzhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te (112)yul med pa'i blo layan gar ba mi srid pa'i phyir na/ rtsa bar ma khyab te gangs ri dang du sogs kyi yul yod pa'i phyir/ des na gzugs kyi skye mched yin la do blo de'i de 'dzakin stangs kyi yul du ma byas pa'i 'khrul bar ser yang*/ don de la dmigs nas skye ba'i phyir ro/ sgyu ma'i rta glang du snang ba lta bu la yang*/ rdol shing dang sa phyogs sogs yin la/ zad par dang mi sdug sogs ni gtso bo yid kyi snangs ba dbang btsan pa'i gzugs kyi skye mched yin la/ rmi lam gyi yul yang chos khams pa'i gzugs te de dag la khyad par yod do/ yang shes pa yul gyi rnam par gyur pa de chos can/ khyod kyis yul mi 'dzin par thal/ rang gi gzung rnam 'dzin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ yul 'dzin gyi shes pa mi srid par 'gyur ro zhes na/ ma khyab te yul gyi rnam pa gtod pa de la/ yul gzung ba'i don yin pa'i phyir te/ shes sa kho gzung ba'i rnam (113)ldan du bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ de dag ni dpyad pa'i sgo tsam te/ rgyas sar gzhan las shes so/ 'phral 'phral shes bya'i gnas lugs de/

zab zab rig pa yang dag gis/ yang yang dpyad na shes mod kyi/ hob hon smra ba mang bas ci/ yang dag rig pa'i mig phyos na/ khyad par gyur pa'i gnas mthong gi dpyod pa kun la ston byed lung*/ gcig pur re rnams su yid rton/ shes bya kun kyang ro gcig tu/ rtog par ma gyur de yi bar/ tshad ma gnyis la mi brten par/ gzhal bya rtogs par 'dod rnams 'khrul/ khyad par rang la lkog gyur pa'i/ gzhal bya phyi ma'i gnas kun ni/ yang dag rgyu mtshan tshol ba las/ rtogs pa'i thabs tshul gzhan yod min/ des na rnam grol don gnyer ba'i/ tshul 'di gzhan du ma lta bar/ 'bad pas (114)dngas du longs shig dang*/ ring por mi thog mkhyen mnga' 'gyur/ zhes kyang spring tshig tu smras so/ ༄༅/ tshul gsum ni phyogs chos rjes khyab/ ldog khyab po/ de dag gi mtshan nyid ni/ shes 'dod chos can gyi steng na 'god tshul dang mthun par yod pa nyid tshad mas nges pa phyogs kyi mtshan nyid/ de sgrub kyi mthun phyogs kho nar yod pa nyid du tshad mas nges pa rjes khyab kyi mtshan nyid/ de sgrub gyi mi mthun phyogs la med pa kho nar tshad mas nges pa ldog khyab gyi mtshan nyid/ (115)bum pa la yin pa las log pa'i cha de rang ldog yin la blos 'dzin tshul la shar rgyu bum pa rang min las log pa tsam yin kyang 'dzin tshul rnam pas brdzis re rang yin par 'dzin pa yin no/ bum pa rang yin pa'i cha de gzhi ldog ldog pa ni rdzas chos thams cad dang dbyer med pa 'dres pa de'i ldog pa'am/ khyad par re re nas blos so sor bkar te 'dzin pa yin no/ cig bkar te bzug nas ni dngos med rang ldog las med/ des na blo don mthun yin na ldog pa re dang sgras brjod tshul de snyed kyi ldog pa re re yod de/ mtshan nyid la yang*/ kho mtshan nyid yin pa mtshan nyid rang ldog kho bum pa'i mtshan nyid yin pa gzhi bum pa dang bcas pa'i tshogs kho shes bya yin pa/ kho gzhal bya yin pa sogs/

rdzas btags gnyis blos 'dzin tshul la rdzas yod chos gsum yul dang nye ba/ btags yod chos gsum blo dang nye bar 'char/ rtog (116)bcas nges bcas dpyod bcas so/ dngos dngos mdo gnyis ka la don spyi snang la de snang ba ltar rang mtshan grub kyis tshad ma dang chad min bzhag la/ spyi mtshan rang ldog dngos mdo rtag pa'o/ don spyi blo rnam so/ den na don spyi rtog pa'i snang yul yin te blo de'i ngor nye bar yod pa'i phyir dang*/ gzung yul yang yin te blos yul 'dzin pa la rnam pa dang sbrol te 'dzin pa'i phyir/ 'dzin stangs sam 'dzin tshul gyi yul bum pa rang mtshan yin te/ der 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ zhen yul te khyad par ram gtso bo'i yul yang rang mtshan bum pa de yin/ de byas sa sogs las bkar te 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ dpe na blo rtog bcas kyi snang tshul la bum pa'i rnam pa gang yang 'dzin stangs rang mtshan du 'dzin pa las blo de'i bum pa 'di chul skyor ba'i don byed pa'i bum pa'o snyam du mi 'dzin/ 'di bum pa'i don spyi'o snyam du mi 'dzin/ 'dzin na rang mtshan dang gnyis ka 'dzin dgos/ dpe na snang tshul la don spyi (117)las mi snang yang 'dzin tshul bum pa rang mtshan yin par 'dzin pa'o/ mdo sems kyi dngos rtogs yin na btag don btsal nas rnyed dgos pas de la yin par shugs rtogs la bzhed/ thal 'gyur pas blo de'i yul de yul du byas pa la rtogs pa zhes btags don tshol mi dgos pas dngos rtogs su gsungs/ dbang shes rtog med zhes rtog pa ni nges pa la go dgos pas de med pa la zer/ yul gsal bar zhes ljon par gyi don yin no/ sems rang rgyud pa la ni/ yid rtog med ni kha nang kho nar phyogs pa'i 'dzin rnam yan gar ba/ dper na mar mes rang gzhan gsal ba ltar shes pa rang shes pa'i ngo bor gsal por skye ba de rang rig pa'o/ 'di rtog med yin te nges pa med pa'i phyir/ rtags kyis sgrub dgos pa'i phyir ro/

yang yid rton med 'phags pa'am las kyis bsgyur ba'i sems can rnams la rtog mdo dbang shes dang mi 'dra bar nges pa dang bcas pa/ rton bcas kyi yid (118)shes dang mi 'dra ba'i yul gsal bar snang ba zhig yod de/ gzhan sems shes pa la pha rol pa'i sems kyi rnam pa gsal bar dmigs pa khyad par ro/ dpe na stong nyid don spyi'i tshul du shar ba yang don spyi don la 'khrul ba'i phyir na/ stong nyid mngon sum rtogs pa la yid rtog med du log dgos so/ grub bde zhes pa skye 'gags gcig pa dang*/ rdzas gzhig zhes pas bum pa'i rdzas gcig la go ba'i byas mi rtag sogs snang yul yin kyang gzung yul ma yin zhes sngon po'i byas pa sogs sngon po dang ngo bor gcig pas sngon po'i rnam par shar yang sngon po byas par mi rtog te de byas par mi 'dzin zhing sgrub 'jug yin pa'i phyir ro/ yang rang nges zhes pa sngon po'am/ gzhan nges zhes pa byas pa'i rtags kyis mi rtag par nges pa'o/ sngon po'i mi rtag pa sogs sngon po'i rnam par snang ba ni yod la/ sngon por byas par yin pa'i 'dra rnam ni ma shar zhes brjod/ rnam pa zhes pa blo de yul de la phar bkram pa'i tshul (119)gyis gsal ba gcig po de yin kyang snang tshul yul la rnam pa yin pa'i cha dang*/ de 'dzin pa'i cha gnyis su snang ba'o/ dngos shugs kyi rtogs pa zhes pa/ dper na shar phyogs kyi bum pa mthong ba'i dus na bum med kyi rnam pa ma shar yang dngos rtogs bum 'dzin gyis bum pa de rdza bum yin pa'i sgro 'dogs bcad zin pas da dngos rtogs de'i rjes ma gzhan du bum med nges pa shugs rtogs yin la/ dpe na shugs rtogs yin la/ des na shugs rtogs la sgro 'dogs dang po bcad zin pas blo de phyogs de la bskor ba tsam gyis nges pa dang*/ ma rtogs pa la gzid sgro 'dogs bcad nges dgos pa'i phyir ro/ deon sgrub ni byas pas mi rtag pa sgrub pa'am/

tha snyad sgrub ni mi rtag pa'i tha snyad mi shes pa la de'i ming de sgrub pa'o/ rang ldogan ni bum pa min palog pa'am rang yin pa'i cha de yin la/ don ldog ni der grub byed kyi mtshan nyid de yin la/ gzhi (120)ldog ni mtshan mtshon gnyid po'i gzhi de yin la/ rdzas kyi ldog pa ni rang mtshan de yin no/ blo ngo'i ldog pa rnam pa de yin no/ gsar du zhes pas bcad shes bcad la tshad ma bsdu ba'o/ mi bsru ba zhes pas ma rtogs pa bcad/ rig pa zhes pas gang zag dang sgra tshad drang srong gi dmod pa dang*/ dngos po tshad ma bre srang sogs bcad do/ rtog bral zhes pas nges pa bcad/ ma 'khrul ba zhes pas snang yul bsru ba bcad do/ yid mngon ni slob dpon chos mchogs gis tshad ma rgyan las gsungs pa la dbang mngon skad cig gi dang po'i rjes ma/ mjug tu yid mngon gcig skye ba btags don btsal nas bzhag pa yin la/ mdo las gsungs pa ni/ thal 'gyur ba'i de'o/ yan lag lnga ldan rim pa bzhin/ khyab pa brjod pa'i tshig dpe brjod pa'i/ rtags brjod pa'i/ khyab 'brel brjod pa'i sgrub bya brjod pa'i tshig go rnal ma ni gnyis/ 'byor ba ni 'jug pa 'jug pas zhi lhag (121)zung 'jug go mi sdug pa sogs rang la snang ba yid kyi chos khams de ma thag pa skye na zhugs pa dang gzhan la snang ba ni gzugs kyi skye mched do/ rang rgyud man chad kyi thal 'gyur gyis rang gzhan gyi log rtog gi rtse gzhom nas blo rtse gnyis su gyur pa la gzod tshul gsum yang dag gis rang rgyud grub dgos la dpe na rang blo ji ltar grub pa ltar gzhan la'ang grub dgos pas chos can mthun snang du grub dgos la/ thal 'gyur pa la thal 'gyur des pha rol po'i log rtog ldog pa dang rjes dpag bskyed pa gnyis kar nus par gsungs/ 'bras mtshungs kyis ltag chod ni sgra dang bum pa'i byas pa de'i rang ldog rkyang sbyar la go na rang gzhan gnyis kas chos gcig rjes su dpag mi nus par mtshungs so/

dngos khyab ni blo'i 'dzin tshul gyi chos can kho na la grub pa dang mi mthun phyogs kho na la ldog pa 'dzin mi dgos par de yin dang (122)de yod du 'dzin pa yin la/ rjes khyab ni yul rtags de'i rjes su bsgrub bya 'gro ba mthun phyogs kho na la sogs pa/ rigs gnas zhes pa rgol ba skabs kyi rtags dang khyab pa re re brjod pas thal 'gyur du 'gro ba las gzhan du ltar snang yin do/ tshad ma'i gsal ba dang*/ bsal bsang 'gal ba dang*/ thal ba bzhi ni don la thal 'gyur yin kyang de'i byed las kyis sgo nas btags pa'o/ rtags rgyu mtshan sgrub byed sogs don gcig pas gang dran dran yin na yin pas khyab te/ rgyu mtshan nam sgrub byed yin la/ de la yang dag yin min yod do/ dper ri rwa rtags/ sgra yod du sgrub pa sogs bzhin no/ tshul gsum grub ma grub kyi ltos gzhi shes 'dod chos can/ de la shes 'dod med pa'am*/ shes zin dang*/ shes 'dod logs par zhugs pa ma yin pa'i gang zag rtags khyab gnyis ka tshad mas nges/ sgrub bya'i chos ma nges pa la'o/ khyab pa'i ltos gzhi sgrub (123)bya'i chos so/ dpe na sbyor ba gtogs pa thams cad 'dir bshad do/ byas pas mi rtag pa/ bsgrub bya'i chos las mi rtag par yin par sgrub pa min te/ gang yin na sgra mi rtag rtag par sgrub pa yin te gnyis tshogs so/ dpe'i mu gsum gyi dang po rjes 'gro'i dpe nges pa dang*/ gnyis pa ldog pa'i dpe dang*/ gsum pa khyab pa mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i dpe'o/ tshul gsum yin pa de'i mtshan nyid la yod pa zhes pas don la ltos pa ma grub sogs gsum gcod/ tshad ma nges pa zhes pas blo la ltos pa'i skyen bcad do/ tshod ba ni/ yul g.yi rnam pa tshur blang ba'i sems so/ 'du byes ni yul gcod pa'i sems byung ngo/ sems pa ni/ sems yul la g.yalo bar byed paḥpa'i sems byung*/ reg pa ni/ sems dang yul 'phrad par byed pa'i sems byung ngo*/

yid byed ni sems yul la 'grogs par byed pa'i sems so/ 'dun pa ni yul la don du gnyer ba'i sems so/ mos (124)ma ni nges pas thag gcod pa'i sems so/ dran pa ni nges zin mi brjod pa'i sems so/ ting nge 'dzin ni yul de dang rgyun ldan du 'grogs pa'i sems/ shes rab ni yul shes pa'i sems byung ngo/ gtan tshig la ltos pa gcig du bral bkod pa lta bu sgrub bya la ltos pa dang*/ rten 'brel bkod pa lta bu dgag byas dag pa'o/ 'di gnyis gsar kha dod ma do lta bu bar du gzhan brgyud dgos mi dgos zhig gi khyad par ro/ ༈ rdzas yod chos gsum ni/ rang mtshan nyid yin pa/ mtshan gzhi'i steng du grub pa/ rang gis mtshon bya min pa gzhan gyis mi mtshin pa/ btags yod chos gsum ni/ rang mtshon bya yin pa/ mtshan gzhi'i steng du grub pa/ rang gis mtshon bya min pa gzhan gyis mi mtshon pa/ btags yod chos gsum ni/ rang mtshon bya yin pa/ mtshan gzhi'i steng du grub pa/ rang gi mtshan nyid min pas m-i mtshon pa'o/ gzung 'dzin grangs mnyam pa'i shes pa rdzas mi gcig pa du ma yin kyang de la dus rim gyis dang gcig char dang skye ba gnyis so/ dang po'i la sngo sor sogs 'dzin pa'i snga phyi'i go rim nges par 'gyur ro zhe na/ (125)ma khyab te/ myur pa la gcig char 'khrul pa'i rgyu yod pa'i phyir dang*/ dper na mgal mo bzhin des na sngo sor sogs kyi rnam pa la ma 'khrul yang cig char ltar snang ba la 'khrul shes yin par bzhed de/ gnyis pa la/ sems can gcig gi rgyud la shes rgyud du mar thalo zer na/ ma khyab te/ mdo mas gsungs pa shes pa rigs la dgongs nas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ de ltar min na gtso sems gcig la kun 'gro lnga sogs dus mnyam skye bar 'galo/ sna tshogs gnyis med pa ni/ yul rdzas mi gcig pa du ma'i rnam pa'ang gtad/ de dag gi rnam par yang skyes kyang rnam pa de dag dbang blo rdzas gcig pa ste/

shes pa rdzas gcig la rnam pa du ma snang ba'i phyir ro/ sgong nga phyed tshal bas bzhed pa ni sngo sor sogs rnam pa gtod byed rdzas tha dad kyang yin/ rnam pa yang so sor 'char yang sngo sor rdzas mi gcig pa bzhin du khra bo'i rnam pas rdzas (126)mi gcig pa yang min/ shes pa sngo sor sogs kyi rnam pa 'char yang sngo sor sogs khra bor cig par rdzas tha dad pa min par bzhed pas yul gyi rnam pa yang khra tsam du rdzas gcig la shes pa yang khra 'dzigan tsam du gcig pas rdzas mi gcig pa med pa gcig tu rloms par bzhed do/// /
